content.summary: Why Cboe’s Fair Value Moved, Even As Growth Assumptions Softened Cboe Global Markets has seen its fair value estimate inch from about US$262.08 to about US$267.77 per share, while the discount rate used in the model has shifted only slightly from about 8.24% to about 8.23%.
